correctness.rationale: The formula and asymptotics are correct. The primary 2010 paper gives the resonant Lorentzian amplitude, the threshold \(\gamma_0=\Gamma/2\), zero local minima, the optimized trace distance \(|b(t)|\), and the BLP measure as the sum over its local maxima. Direct differentiation gives stationary times \(2\pi n/\kappa\) and heights \(e^{-\pi\Gamma n/\kappa}\); summing the geometric series gives the claimed closed form. The hyperbolic/boundary amplitude is monotone on the closed Markovian side. Substitution \(\kappa=\Gamma\sqrt\varepsilon\) gives the flat exponential onset, and the Bernoulli expansion of \((e^x-1)^{-1}\) gives the stated strong-coupling series. The inspected checker independently confirms derivative, revival, sum, and asymptotic calculations.

originality.rationale: Full primary text of Xu--Yang--Feng was obtained and read. It already gives the explicit resonant trigonometric amplitude, proves that all relevant minima are zero, proves the optimizing trace distance is \(|b(t)|\), and writes the BLP non-Markovianity as the sum of \(|b|\) over all local maxima. Differentiating that displayed elementary function identifies a geometric progression of maxima; summing it and taking standard asymptotics are routine consequences. Under implication-based originality, the fact that the closed sum and flat-onset wording are not printed in the source does not make them independent discoveries.
residual_risks: A later source may print the same closed form explicitly, but that is unnecessary for the coverage verdict because the 2010 source already implies it.
